desc:
Welcome to Super Hero Tycoon 😄, choose your favorite superhero 🦸 and build 🧱 your tycoon! 

You purchase droppers 🏗️ that generate cash 💸, when you have enough cash you will be able to unlock different weapons ⚔️ of your chosen superhero and unlock the superhero outfit 🧣.

The objective of the game is to unlock all weapons 🗡️ of the chosen superhero and the superhero outfit inside your tycoon 🦸! Fight others to defend your tycoon and become the most powerful superhero ✨ in the game! Make sure to invite or make friends 👥 along the way that can help you build your tycoon and fight others 👊!

Join Felt's And Like The Game ❤️ for 100 starting cash 💰:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/group.aspx?gid=11010605
In the group, you can also find our other tycoon games 🎮, and you can chat with the community 👪. Make sure to post about your game/update ideas 🤔 on our group wall!

Make sure to favorite ⭐ and thumbs up 👍 the game to show your support!
